anim_set_lock.FIGHT: every move in this file: moveset moves and combat stances — the combat animation bank
anim_set_lock.SHOW: win poses, intro poses, taunts, cutscene animations — intro/win slots and cutscenes ONLY; bank clips in game/assets/anim/t3/anna/ (t3_stance.json → intro slot, t3_win_*.json → win slots); must NEVER enter this moveset without the user's explicit approval
anim_set_lock.note: per-move 'set' tags stamp what each pull lane added; the file itself is the FIGHT set

frame_convention: T3 60fps -> seconds; damage scaled T3 170HP -> WH 100HP

generated_full_moveset.note: Full T3 bank depth merged over curated base; curated moves preserved verbatim. 413 rows, 242 attacks.

canon_note: Torch WH signature moves preserved; T8 Anna frame data folded in.

forward_merge.method: semantic union of branch (moveset-cluster-a-t8) and main versions; main keeps contested move keys, branch entries rekeyed <key>_t8 with t8_input recorded; colliding branch specials appended with forward_merge_alt_of

expansion.note: Additive expansion from real T3 teardown bank rows. Existing moves untouched.
